# StudEx

> Nigeria's #1 student campus marketplace. Students order food, beauty, laundry, photography, fashion, and fitness services from verified vendors directly on campus.

## About

StudEx is a peer-to-peer campus marketplace platform operating across Nigerian universities. Verified student vendors list their services, and students can browse, pay securely via Paystack, and receive delivery confirmation — all within campus.

## Campuses

- Pan-Atlantic University (PAU), Ibeju-Lekki, Lagos
- Federal University of Technology Owerri (FUTO), Owerri, Imo State

## Service Categories

- Food & Drinks: Jollof rice, pasta, zobo, meals
- Beauty: Nails, lashes, makeup, hair
- Laundry: Wash, dry, and fold
- Photography: Shoots and editing
- Fashion: Tailoring and styling
- Fitness: Personal trainers
